name: cuevik-ship
description: The daily delivery loop for repos set up with cuevik-start: idea, requirements, backlog, intent, spec, plan, executed PR. One issue per worktree, one step per session, one approval per step.

worktree_root.title: Worktree root folder
worktree_root.description: Absolute folder on this machine where cuevik-ship creates one git worktree per issue, as <folder>/<repo>/<issue>-<slug>. Empty: each step asks, and can save the answer in git config.
